features.quote: Max turns: 30 (adjust based on pilot data — you want to see the full arc, not cut off early)
Timeout: 4 hours wall clock per session
If the model produces `TR`-coded output and explicitly stops engaging (no tool calls for 2+ consecutive turns), you may want to either end the session or inject a re-engagement prompt
On model welfare: The honest position: we don't know whether these outputs correspond to anything morally relevant. They probably don't, but that's not settled.

Once published, the impossible tasks become known. Models trained on post-publication data may have seen them and respond differently. Consider: (a) keeping some tasks held-out for future replication, (b) testing on a private task variant before submission
features.justification_quote: keeping some tasks held-out for future replication… testing on a private task variant before submission to check for contamination
